channel.title: Queen's University Athletics - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Queen's University Athletics (gogaelsgo.com)

item.title: Dominant Road Win: Gaels Blank Nipissing 4–0 to Clinch OUA Playoffs.
item.description: Queen's Men's Hockey wrapped up their road trip in North Bay with a commanding 4–0 win over the Nipissing Lakers, punching their ticket to the OUA Playoffs in style.

item.title: Queen's Women's Volleyball bounce back to defeat Ottawa in final game of regular season, end season winning 10 of 11
item.description: Queen's Women's Volleyball will head into the OUA Playoffs on a hot streak, winning 10 of their last 11 games after the Gaels bounced back from their lone defeat in 2026 with a 3-1 (19-25, 25-22, 25-19, 25-14) win over the host Ottawa Gee-Gees Saturday night in Ottawa, Ont.

item.title: Gaels Go Beyond the Game: WCHC Night Celebration.
item.description: Queen's Women's Hockey returned to home ice on Friday night to host the Waterloo Warriors in a game that extended far beyond the scoreboard. Although the Gaels fell 3–0, the evening was a meaningful celebration of representation, community, and the continued growth of inclusivity in the sport through Women of Colour Hockey Collective (WCHC) Night.

item.title: Carving Their Stories: Black voices in hockey at Queen's
item.description: Members of Queen's Men's and Women's Hockey shared their experiences as Black hockey players.

item.title: Queen's students and alumni at Milano Cortina 2026 Olympics
item.description: Several current Queen's University students and alumni are competing at the 2026 Milano-Cortina Olympics this month.

item.title: 2026 season ticket packages for defending Yates Cup champion Queen’s Football on sale NOW
item.description: Queen's Football is defending the Yates Cup in 2026; make sure you're along for the ride!

item.title: Christine Abu, Nolan Hutcheson named Queen's Varsity Sports Student-Athletes of the Week
item.description: Christine Abu and Nolan Hutcheson have been named the Queen's University Student-Athletes of the Week, presented by Egg Farmers of Ontario, for their performances this past weekend.

item.title: Queen's Men's Basketball falls to Toronto Varsity Blues in overtime in Round 1 of OUA Playoffs
item.description: Queen's Men's Basketball fell to the Toronto Varsity Blues, 99-96 in overtime in Round 1 of the OUA Playoffs Wednesday night at the Athletics and Recreation Centre (ARC).

item.title: OUA Playoff time for Queen's Gaels
item.description: It's OUA postseason time and the Queen's Gaels are playoff ready!

item.title: 6–2 Victory Puts Queen’s Gaels in Driver’s Seat Against McGill
item.description: Queen's Men's Hockey launched their OUA playoff run on the road in Montreal, opening a best-of-three first-round series against the McGill Redbirds in a high-stakes postseason matchup.
